decisions.reason: The schlager compilation CD is somewhat outside the firm's core reissue focus, but its existing knowledge of compiling and selling physical music CDs still provides sufficient absorptive capacity to learn from early sales and improve the product.
The illustrated music release series builds directly on the firm's experience in curated, carefully produced physical editions, enabling it to interpret feedback and refine the line.
Reissuing jazz on vinyl aligns squarely with the firm's core competence in overlooked music reissues, giving it strong absorptive capacity to assess and enhance the product.
Multi-disc box sets draw on the firm's established knowledge of physical music production and curation, allowing effective learning from market response.

The compilation music CD fits the firm's existing ability to curate and sell physical music, though its generic nature gives slightly less absorptive capacity than specialized reissues, it still warrants keeping.
